verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Scheduled Flags, which queue a flag change to apply automatically at a set future time. It also documents Release Pipelines, which move flags through stages automatically using triggers and actions. Both are one-off or event-driven automations, and nothing shows recurring (cron-style) schedules or general-purpose job scheduling. Missing for 10: recurring/repeating schedule support, scheduling of arbitrary jobs beyond flag changes, evidence that schedules can be created via API/MCP/CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration.
